_header: A hook that is not registered is just a file on disk. This is the wiring
that turns guard.ts from text into a rule with teeth.
The harness reads this file when a session starts. hooks.PreToolUse is a
list of matchers; matcher 'Write|Edit' is a regex over tool names, so the
command below runs before either of those tools acts. The command gets the
pending call as JSON on stdin; exit 2 cancels it. Nothing here executes on
its own — it only says what runs, and when.
The hook never runs and no error is printed. The system looks guarded and
is not, which is worse than being visibly unguarded.
product wires its own pieces in code it owns; a personal system asks the
harness to do the wiring and lives with the harness's rules.
(Header lives in a data key because strict JSON has no comments; the
harness ignores keys it does not know.)
